AddAITemplate.description_en: Adds an AI template for automated review and smart thumbnail tasks
AddAITemplate.description_zh: 调用本接口添加智能审核和智能封面任务需要使用的AI模板

AddCategory.description_en: Creates a category to classify audio, video, image, and short video materials stored in ApsaraVideo VOD, making resource discovery and management more efficient
AddCategory.description_zh: 通过调用本接口来创建分类，可以有效地对存储在视频点播平台上的音视频、图片及短视频素材进行归类，从而使得资源的查找与管理变得更加高效便捷

AddEditingProject.description_en: Creates an online editing project (video editing task)
AddEditingProject.description_zh: 调用本接口创建云剪辑工程（视频编辑任务）

AddEditingProjectMaterials.description_en: Adds one or more materials to an online editing project
AddEditingProjectMaterials.description_zh: 将一个或多个素材添加到剪辑工程中

AddTranscodeTemplateGroup.description_en: Adds transcoding configurations. You can create a transcoding template group or add transcoding templates to a specified template group
AddTranscodeTemplateGroup.description_zh: 调用本接口添加转码配置信息，可创建新的转码模板组，或者向指定模板组中添加新的转码模板

AddVodDomain.description_en: Adds a domain name for CDN acceleration in ApsaraVideo VOD
AddVodDomain.description_zh: 调用本接口添加点播加速域名

AddVodStorageForApp.description_en: Binds a storage bucket to a sub-application of ApsaraVideo VOD
AddVodStorageForApp.description_zh: 为视频点播的子应用绑定存储Bucket

AddVodTemplate.description_en: Adds a snapshot or animated image template
AddVodTemplate.description_zh: 调用本接口添加截图或动图模板

AddWatermark.description_en: To simplify watermark task processing, ApsaraVideo VOD consolidates complex watermark parameters such as position, size, font, and color into templates, each identified by a unique watermark template ID. Calls this operation to add an image or text watermark template
AddWatermark.description_zh: 为了简化水印任务的处理过程，视频点播将复杂的水印位置、水印大小、水印文字的字体、颜色等水印参数固化成模板，并通过具有唯一性的水印模板ID来指代。调用本接口可以添加图片水印模板或文字水印模板

AttachAppPolicyToIdentity.description_en: Invokes this operation to attach access permissions of an ApsaraVideo VOD application to a specified identity (Resource Access Management (RAM) user or RAM role)
AttachAppPolicyToIdentity.description_zh: 调用本接口为指定身份（RAM用户或RAM角色）附加点播应用的访问权限

BatchGetMediaInfos.description_en: Retrieves the basic information and source file information of multiple media assets in a batch
BatchGetMediaInfos.description_zh: 批量获取媒资基础信息和源文件信息

BatchSetVodDomainConfigs.description_en: Configures multiple accelerated domain names in a batch
BatchSetVodDomainConfigs.description_zh: 调用本接口批量配置加速域名

BatchStartVodDomain.description_en: Enables an accelerated domain name that is in the Disabled state
BatchStartVodDomain.description_zh: 调用本接口启用状态为“停用”的加速域名

BatchStopVodDomain.description_zh: 调用本接口暂停域名加速

CancelUrlUploadJobs.description_en: Cancels URL upload tasks that are in the queue
CancelUrlUploadJobs.description_zh: 取消排队中的URL上传任务

ChangeResourceGroup.description_en: Transfers a resource to a different resource group
ChangeResourceGroup.description_zh: 调用本接口将资源进行转组

CreateAppInfo.description_zh: 调用本接口创建新的应用

CreateAudit.description_en: Submits a manual review request to review media information such as videos and audio files
CreateAudit.description_zh: 调用本接口进行人工审核，可用于审核视频、音频等媒体信息

CreateUploadAttachedMedia.description_en: The upload URL and credential are provided by ApsaraVideo VOD to address authorization and security concerns, prevent malicious uploads, and enable automatic creation of a media asset ID (MediaId) for management and processing. For auxiliary media assets such as watermarks and subtitles, invoke this operation to obtain the upload credential and create the corresponding media asset information
CreateUploadAttachedMedia.description_zh: 上传地址和凭证由点播服务提供，旨在解决授权与安全问题，防止恶意上传，并自动创建用于管理和处理的媒资ID（Mediaid）。辅助媒资如水印、字幕等，通过调用本接口获取上传凭证并创建相应媒资信息

CreateUploadImage.description_en: Retrieves the upload URL and upload credential for uploading an image to ApsaraVideo VOD, and creates image information. ApsaraVideo VOD issues upload URLs and credentials to ensure authorization and security, prevent malicious uploads, and supports automatic creation of an image ID (ImageId) for management. You can invoke this operation to obtain the upload URL and credential and create image information
CreateUploadImage.description_zh: 点播服务下发上传地址和凭证以保障授权和安全，防止恶意上传，并在下发时自动创建图片ID（ImageId）用于管理。通过调用本接口可获取上传所需地址和凭证，并创建图片信息

CreateUploadVideo.description_en: ApsaraVideo VOD issues the upload URL and upload credential to ensure authorization and security and prevent malicious uploads. During issuance, a media ID (MediaId), also called a video ID (VideoId), undergoes automatic creation for management. Invoke this operation to obtain the upload URL and upload credential, and create audio or video information
CreateUploadVideo.description_zh: 点播服务下发上传地址和凭证以保障授权和安全，防止恶意上传，并在下发时自动创建媒体ID（MediaId），也叫视频ID（VideoId）用于管理。通过调用本接口可获取上传所需地址和凭证，并创建音视频信息

DecryptKMSDataKey.description_en: Invokes this operation to perform decryption on the CiphertextBlob in a KMS data key (DK)
DecryptKMSDataKey.description_zh: 通过调用本接口解密KMS数据密钥中的CiphertextBlob密文

DeleteAIImageInfos.description_zh: 调用本接口删除AI图片信息

DeleteAppInfo.description_zh: 调用本接口删除应用信息

DeleteAttachedMedia.description_en: Deletes one or more auxiliary media assets that have been uploaded to ApsaraVideo VOD, such as watermark images, subtitle files, and materials
DeleteAttachedMedia.description_zh: 当水印图片、字幕文件、素材等辅助媒体资源上传至视频点播后，可以利用本接口能进行单个或批量的删除操作

DeleteCategory.description_en: Deletes a category and its subcategories
DeleteCategory.description_zh: 调用本接口删除分类及其子分类

DeleteDynamicImage.description_zh: 调用本接口删除动图信息

DeleteEditingProject.description_zh: 调用本接口删除云剪辑工程

DeleteEditingProjectMaterials.description_en: Deletes materials from an online editing project
DeleteEditingProjectMaterials.description_zh: 删除云剪辑工程的待剪辑素材

DeleteImage.description_en: Deletes images uploaded by users or images generated from video snapshots
DeleteImage.description_zh: 调用本接口删除用户上传的图片或视频截图生成的图片

DeleteMessageCallback.description_en: Deletes the callback method, callback URL, and event types of an event notification
DeleteMessageCallback.description_zh: 调用本接口删除事件通知的回调方式、回调地址、事件类型

DeleteMezzanines.description_en: Deletes the source files of multiple audio and video files at a time
DeleteMezzanines.description_zh: 批量删除音视频源文件信息

DeleteMultipartUpload.description_en: Deletes fragment files generated during upload
DeleteMultipartUpload.description_zh: 删除上传中产生的碎片文件

DeleteStream.description_en: Deletes media stream (video stream or audio stream) information and storage files
DeleteStream.description_zh: 删除媒体流（视频流，音频流）信息及存储文件

DeleteTranscodeTemplateGroup.description_en: Deletes transcoding configurations. You can delete specific transcoding templates from a transcoding template group or force delete an entire transcoding template group
DeleteTranscodeTemplateGroup.description_zh: 删除转码配置信息，可删除转码模板组下的部分转码模板，也可强制删除整个转码模板组

DeleteVideo.description_en: Deletes complete videos, including video source files, transcoded stream files, and thumbnails
DeleteVideo.description_zh: 删除完整视频（包括视频源文件、转码后的流文件、封面截图等）

DeleteVodDomain.description_en: Deletes an accelerated domain name that has been added for ApsaraVideo VOD
DeleteVodDomain.description_zh: 调用本接口删除已添加的点播加速域名

DeleteVodSpecificConfig.description_en: Deletes the configurations of a domain name for CDN acceleration in ApsaraVideo VOD
DeleteVodSpecificConfig.description_zh: 调用本接口删除点播加速域名的配置

DeleteVodTemplate.description_zh: 调用本接口删除截图模板

DeleteWatermark.description_en: Deletes an image watermark template or text watermark template by watermark template ID
DeleteWatermark.description_zh: 调用本接口通过水印模板ID删除图片水印模板或文字水印模板

DescribeMediaDistribution.description_en: Queries the time-based distribution of audio and video media assets. The maximum time span between the start time and end time is six months
DescribeMediaDistribution.description_zh: 查询音视频媒资数据按时间分布。起止时间跨度最大6个月

DescribePlayTopVideos.description_en: Retrieves daily playback statistics for top videos, including the number of views, unique viewers, and total playback duration
DescribePlayTopVideos.description_zh: 调用本接口获取每日TOP视频的播放数据统计，统计指标包括播放次数、播放用户数和播放总时长

DescribePlayUserAvg.description_en: Retrieves daily average playback statistics for a specified time range, including average playback duration and average playback count
DescribePlayUserAvg.description_zh: 调用本接口获取指定时间范围内的每日播放数据均量统计，统计指标包括平均播放时长、平均播放次数

DescribePlayUserTotal.description_en: Retrieves the total daily playback statistics within a specified time range, including total play count, total unique viewers, total playback duration, and playback duration distribution
DescribePlayUserTotal.description_zh: 调用本接口获取指定时间范围内的每日播放数据总量统计，统计指标包括总播放次数、总播放用户数、总播放时长、播放时长分布

DescribePlayVideoStatis.description_en: Queries the daily playback statistics of a specified video within a specified time range. The statistics include total playback duration, number of playbacks, number of unique viewers, and playback duration distribution
DescribePlayVideoStatis.description_zh: 调用本接口查询指定视频在指定时间范围内的每日播放统计数据，统计指标包括播放总时长、播放次数、播放用户数和播放时长分布

DescribeVodAIData.description_en: Queries usage data of AI processing services such as automated review and media fingerprint
DescribeVodAIData.description_zh: 调用本接口查询AI处理（智能审核、视频DNA等）的用量数据

DescribeVodCertificateList.description_zh: 调用本接口获取证书列表信息

DescribeVodDomainBpsData.description_en: Invokes this operation to query the bandwidth data of an accelerated domain name. Compared with the DescribeVodDomainRealTimeBpsData operation, this operation supports a longer time range for historical data queries (up to 366 days) but provides a larger data time granularity (minimum of 5 minutes) and higher data latency
DescribeVodDomainBpsData.description_zh: 调用本接口查询加速域名的带宽数据，相比DescribeVodDomainRealTimeBpsData接口，本接口支持可查询的历史数据时间范围更长（最长可查询最近366天的数据），但其数据时间粒度更大（最小为5分钟），数据延迟更高

DescribeVodDomainBpsDataByLayer.description_en: Queries bandwidth data of accelerated domain names by protocol type
DescribeVodDomainBpsDataByLayer.description_zh: 调用本接口按协议类型查询加速域名的带宽数据

DescribeVodDomainCertificateInfo.description_en: Retrieves the certificate information of a specified accelerated domain name
DescribeVodDomainCertificateInfo.description_zh: 调用本接口获取指定加速域名的证书信息

DescribeVodDomainConfigs.description_en: Queries domain name configurations. You can query multiple feature configurations in a single request
DescribeVodDomainConfigs.description_zh: 调用本接口查询域名配置，一次可查询多个功能配置

DescribeVodDomainDetail.description_en: Retrieves the basic configuration information of a specified China domain name for video-on-demand (VOD) acceleration
DescribeVodDomainDetail.description_zh: 调用本接口获取指定点播域名配置的基本信息

DescribeVodDomainHitRateData.description_en: Queries the byte hit ratio (percentage of hit bytes) of an accelerated domain name
DescribeVodDomainHitRateData.description_zh: 调用本接口查询加速域名的字节命中率（命中字节百分比）

DescribeVodDomainLog.description_en: Retrieves the download URLs of raw CDN access logs for a specified domain name
DescribeVodDomainLog.description_zh: 调用本接口获取指定域名的CDN原始访问日志下载地址

DescribeVodDomainMax95BpsData.description_en: Queries the 95th percentile bandwidth monitoring data for accelerated domain names
DescribeVodDomainMax95BpsData.description_zh: 调用本接口查询加速域名95带宽峰值监控数据

DescribeVodDomainQpsData.description_en: Queries the queries per second (QPS) of accelerated domain names at a 5-minute granularity. Data from the last 90 days is supported
DescribeVodDomainQpsData.description_zh: 获取5分钟计算粒度加速域名的每秒访问次数QPS，支持获取最近90天的数据

DescribeVodDomainRealTimeBpsData.description_en: Invokes this operation to query the bandwidth data of an accelerated domain name. Compared with the DescribeVodDomainBpsData operation, this operation supports a smaller time granularity (minimum of 1 minute), lower data latency (minimum of 5 minutes), but a shorter historical data time range (up to 186 days)
DescribeVodDomainRealTimeBpsData.description_zh: 调用本接口查询加速域名的带宽数据，相比DescribeVodDomainBpsData接口，本接口支持查询的数据时间粒度更小（最小为1分钟），数据延迟更低（最少为5分钟），但可查询的历史数据时间范围更短（最长可查询最近186天的数据）

DescribeVodDomainRealTimeByteHitRateData.description_en: Queries the byte hit rate data of accelerated domain names. This operation supports a minimum time granularity of 1 minute, with a data delay of at least 5 minutes, and allows you to query data from the last 186 days
DescribeVodDomainRealTimeByteHitRateData.description_zh: 调用本接口查询加速域名的字节命中率数据。本接口支持查询的数据时间粒度最小为1分钟，数据延迟最少为5分钟，最长可查询最近186天的数据

DescribeVodDomainRealTimeDetailData.description_en: Queries real-time access data for accelerated domain names, including QPS, bandwidth, and HTTP status code data within the last 7 days
DescribeVodDomainRealTimeDetailData.description_zh: 调用本接口查询加速域名的实时访问数据，可查询最近7天内的QPS、带宽、HTTP状态码数据

DescribeVodDomainRealTimeHttpCodeData.description_en: Queries the total number and proportion of HTTP status codes for an accelerated domain name. This operation supports a minimum data time granularity of 1 minute, with a data delay of at least 5 minutes, and allows you to query data from the last 186 days
DescribeVodDomainRealTimeHttpCodeData.description_zh: 调用本接口查询加速域名HTTP状态码的总数和占比数据。本接口支持查询的数据时间粒度最小为1分钟，数据延迟最少为5分钟，最长可查询最近186天的数据

DescribeVodDomainRealTimeQpsData.description_en: Invoke this operation to query the queries per second (QPS) data for access to an accelerated domain name. This operation supports a minimum data time granularity of 1 minute, with a data delay of at least 5 minutes, and allows you to query data from the last 186 days
DescribeVodDomainRealTimeQpsData.description_zh: 调用本接口查询加速域名每秒访问次数的数据。本接口支持查询的数据时间粒度最小为1分钟，数据延迟最少为5分钟，最长可查询最近186天的数据

DescribeVodDomainRealTimeReqHitRateData.description_en: Queries the request hit ratio data for an accelerated domain name. The minimum time granularity for data queried by this operation is 1 minute. The data latency is at least 5 minutes. You can query data for up to the last 186 days
DescribeVodDomainRealTimeReqHitRateData.description_zh: 调用本接口查询加速域名的请求命中率数据。本接口支持查询的数据时间粒度最小为1分钟，数据延迟最少为5分钟，最长可查询最近186天的数据

DescribeVodDomainRealTimeTrafficData.description_en: Invokes this operation to query the traffic data of an accelerated domain name. Compared with the DescribeVodDomainTrafficData operation, this operation supports a smaller time granularity (minimum of 1 minute), lower data latency (minimum of 5 minutes), but a shorter historical data range (up to 186 days)
DescribeVodDomainRealTimeTrafficData.description_zh: 调用本接口查询加速域名的流量数据，相比DescribeVodDomainTrafficData接口，本接口支持查询的数据时间粒度更小（最小为1分钟），数据延迟更低（最少为5分钟），但可查询的历史数据时间范围更短（最长可查询最近186天的数据）

DescribeVodDomainReqHitRateData.description_en: Queries the request hit ratio (percentage of hit requests) of an accelerated domain name
DescribeVodDomainReqHitRateData.description_zh: 调用本接口查询加速域名的请求命中率（命中请求百分比）

DescribeVodDomainSrcBpsData.description_en: Queries the back-to-origin bandwidth data of accelerated domain names
DescribeVodDomainSrcBpsData.description_zh: 调用本接口查询加速域名的回源带宽数据

DescribeVodDomainSrcTrafficData.description_en: Queries the back-to-origin traffic data of accelerated domain names
DescribeVodDomainSrcTrafficData.description_zh: 调用本接口查询加速域名的回源流量数据

DescribeVodDomainTrafficData.description_en: Invokes this operation to query the traffic data of an accelerated domain name. Compared with the DescribeVodDomainRealTimeTrafficData operation, this operation supports a longer historical data query range (up to 366 days) but provides a larger data time granularity (minimum of 5 minutes) and higher data latency
DescribeVodDomainTrafficData.description_zh: 调用本接口查询加速域名的流量数据，相比DescribeVodDomainRealTimeTrafficData接口，本接口支持可查询的历史数据时间范围更长（最长可查询最近366天的数据），但其数据时间粒度更大（最小为5分钟），数据延迟更高

DescribeVodDomainUsageData.description_en: Queries acceleration traffic or bandwidth usage data
DescribeVodDomainUsageData.description_zh: 调用本接口查询加速流量或带宽用量数据

DescribeVodEditingUsageData.description_en: Queries the usage data of online editing in ApsaraVideo VOD
DescribeVodEditingUsageData.description_zh: 调用DescribeVodEditingUsageData查询点播云剪辑用量

DescribeVodMediaPlayData.description_en: Retrieves playback data of an audio or video file on a specified date by media ID (audio or video ID), including the number of unique visitors, average plays per user, total plays, average play duration per user, and total play duration
DescribeVodMediaPlayData.description_zh: 通过媒体ID（即音视频ID）获取音视频在指定日期的播放数据，包括访问用户数、人均播放次数、播放总次数、人均播放时长、累计播放时长等数据

DescribeVodPlayerCollectData.description_en: Queries aggregated playback data of the player
DescribeVodPlayerCollectData.description_zh: 查询播放器播放汇总的数据

DescribeVodPlayerDimensionData.description_en: Queries the dimension metadata of the player
DescribeVodPlayerDimensionData.description_zh: 查询播放器维度元信息

DescribeVodRangeDataByLocateAndIspServic.description_en: Queries access data for an accelerated domain name by ISP or region, including bandwidth, average response rate, page views, cache hit ratio, and request hit ratio
DescribeVodRangeDataByLocateAndIspServic.description_zh: 调用本接口按运营商或地域查询加速域名的访问数据，包括带宽、响应平均速率、页面浏览量、缓存命中率、请求命中率等数据

DescribeVodRefreshQuota.description_en: Queries the maximum number and remaining daily quota of URLs and directories for purge and prefetch operations
DescribeVodRefreshQuota.description_zh: 调用本接口查询刷新预热URL及目录的最大限制数量和当日剩余数量

DescribeVodRefreshTasks.description_en: Queries whether purge and prefetch tasks have taken effect
DescribeVodRefreshTasks.description_zh: 调用本接口查询刷新和预热状态是否生效

DescribeVodSSLCertificateList.description_en: Queries certificate list information by domain name
DescribeVodSSLCertificateList.description_zh: 调用本接口按照域名查询证书列表信息

DescribeVodStorageData.description_en: Queries the usage of media asset management, including storage space and outbound storage traffic
DescribeVodStorageData.description_zh: 调用本接口查询媒资管理（存储空间、存储流出流量）的用量

DescribeVodTieringStorageData.description_en: Queries the usage of tiered storage for media asset management
DescribeVodTieringStorageData.description_zh: 查询媒资管理分级存储的用量

DescribeVodTieringStorageRetrievalData.description_en: Queries the retrieval data usage of tiered storage in media asset management
DescribeVodTieringStorageRetrievalData.description_zh: 查询媒资管理分级存储的取回数据用量

DescribeVodTranscodeData.description_zh: 调用本接口查询转码用量数据

DescribeVodUserDomains.description_en: Queries the list of all acceleration domain names under your account for ApsaraVideo VOD
DescribeVodUserDomains.description_zh: 调用本接口查询用户名下所有的点播加速域名列表

DescribeVodUserVipsByDomain.description_en: Queries the IP list of a domain name

DescribeVodVerifyContent.description_en: Retrieves the domain ownership verification content
DescribeVodVerifyContent.description_zh: 调用本接口获取归属校验内容

DetachAppPolicyFromIdentity.description_en: Invokes this operation to revoke application authorization from a specified account identity (Resource Access Management (RAM) user or RAM role)
DetachAppPolicyFromIdentity.description_zh: 调用本接口为指定账号身份（RAM用户或RAM角色）撤销指定的应用授权

GenerateDownloadSecretKey.description_en: Generates a key for secure download. The secure download feature of ApsaraVideo Player SDK encrypts videos downloaded to local devices by using a key file. The encrypted videos can only be decrypted and played by using the key file generated by the unique app that is bindable in advance. This effectively protects video content and prevents downloaded videos from being maliciously played or distributed
GenerateDownloadSecretKey.description_zh: 阿里云播放器SDK的安全下载功能，可使视频下载到本地时经密钥文件进行加密，让其仅能通过预先绑定的唯一App生成的密钥文件进行解密播放，可有效保护视频内容，防止下载到本地的视频被恶意播放或传播。调用本接口可生成用于安全下载的密钥

GenerateKMSDataKey.description_en: Invokes the operation to generate a random KMS data key (DK) for ApsaraVideo VOD HLS encryption
GenerateKMSDataKey.description_zh: 通过调用本接口生成一个随机的KMS数据密钥，用于视频点播标准加密

GetAIImageJobs.description_en: Queries the list of AI image processing tasks
GetAIImageJobs.description_zh: 调用本接口查询AI图片任务列表

GetAIMediaAuditJob.description_en: Queries an automated review job. After you submit an AI job, the job is processed asynchronously. You can call this operation to query job information in real time
GetAIMediaAuditJob.description_zh: 调用本接口查询智能审核作业，在提交AI作业后，会进行异步处理，通过此接口可以实时查询作业信息

GetAIVideoTagResult.description_en: Retrieves the results of smart tagging for a video
GetAIVideoTagResult.description_zh: 调用本接口获取智能标签结果

GetAppInfos.description_en: Queries application information by application ID
GetAppInfos.description_zh: 调用本接口通过应用ID查询应用信息

GetAppPlayKey.description_en: Retrieves the playback key of an application

GetAttachedMediaInfo.description_en: Retrieves the basic information and access URLs of multiple auxiliary media assets in a batch by specifying their IDs after the assets such as watermark images, subtitle files, and materials are uploaded to ApsaraVideo VOD
GetAttachedMediaInfo.description_zh: 当水印图片、字幕文件、素材等辅助媒资上传到视频点播后，可以调用本接口传入多个辅助媒资ID批量获取辅助媒资的基本信息及访问地址

GetAuditHistory.description_en: Retrieves the history of manual review records
GetAuditHistory.description_zh: 调用本接口获取人工审核的历史记录

GetCategories.description_en: Invokes this operation to perform a filtered query for specified categorization information by ID or type, and retrieves the list of its subcategories (next-level categories)
GetCategories.description_zh: 调用本接口按ID或类型来筛选查询指定的分类信息，及其子分类（即下一级分类）的列表

GetDailyPlayRegionStatis.description_en: Retrieves the full traffic data of media assets for a specified date and region. The data is generated based on CDN traffic logs and primarily reflects the traffic consumption of videos. The generated CSV file contains the following information: date, video ID, domain name, traffic, application ID, and category ID. You can download the file to your local machine for scenarios such as operational data analytics
GetDailyPlayRegionStatis.description_zh: 获取指定日期和区域的全量媒资流量数据。该数据基于CDN流量日志生成，主要反映视频的流量消耗情况。生成的CSV文件中包含以下信息：日期、视频ID、域名、流量、应用ID、分类ID等。您可以将文件下载到本地，用于运营数据分析等场景

GetDefaultAITemplate.description_zh: 调用本接口查询默认AI模板

GetDigitalWatermarkExtractResult.description_en: Queries the results of a digital watermarking (copyright watermark or tracing watermark) extraction job, including the job status and the successfully extracted watermark text
GetDigitalWatermarkExtractResult.description_zh: 通过调用本接口查询数字水印（版权水印或溯源水印）的提取作业结果，包括数字水印提取作业的状态、成功提取出的水印文字等信息

GetEditingProject.description_en: Retrieves the details of an online editing project (video editing task)
GetEditingProject.description_zh: 调用本接口进行获取云剪辑工程（视频编辑任务）的详细信息

GetEditingProjectMaterials.description_en: Retrieves the list of materials to be edited in an online editing project
GetEditingProjectMaterials.description_zh: 调用本接口获取云剪辑工程的待剪辑素材列表

GetImageInfo.description_en: Retrieves the basic information and access URL of an image by image ID after the image is uploaded to ApsaraVideo VOD
GetImageInfo.description_zh: 图片上传至视频点播后，可调用本接口通过图片ID获取其基本信息及访问地址

GetImageInfos.description_en: Queries the basic information and access URLs of multiple images by image ID after the images are uploaded to ApsaraVideo VOD
GetImageInfos.description_zh: 图片上传到视频点播后，可以调用本接口通过传入多个图片ID，批量获取图片的基本信息及访问地址

GetJobDetail.description_en: Queries the details of an asynchronous task by job ID
GetJobDetail.description_zh: 调用本接口根据jobId查询异步任务详情

GetMediaAiAnalysis.description_en: Retrieves the results of video AI analysis
GetMediaAiAnalysis.description_zh: 获取视频AI分析结果信息

GetMediaAuditAudioResultDetail.description_en: Retrieves the details of audio automated review results
GetMediaAuditAudioResultDetail.description_zh: 调用本接口获取音频审核详情

GetMediaAuditResult.description_en: Retrieves the summary of automated review results
GetMediaAuditResult.description_zh: 调用本接口获取智能审核结果摘要信息

GetMediaAuditResultDetail.description_en: Retrieves the details of automated review results. You can call this operation to query the details of review results in real time
GetMediaAuditResultDetail.description_zh: 调用本接口获取智能审核结果详情。通过此接口可实时查询审核结果详情

GetMediaAuditResultTimeline.description_en: Retrieves the timestamps of all screenshots that contain violations
GetMediaAuditResultTimeline.description_zh: 调用本接口获取到所有违规内容截图的时间点

GetMediaDNAResult.description_en: Retrieves media fingerprint results. After a media fingerprint job is complete, you can call this operation to query the results in real time
GetMediaDNAResult.description_zh: 调用本接口获取视频DNA结果。视频DNA作业完成后，可通过此接口实时查询DNA结果

GetMediaRefreshJobs.description_en: Queries task information such as task status and filtering policies for a video purge or prefetch task
GetMediaRefreshJobs.description_zh: 调用本接口查询视频刷新或预热任务的任务状态、筛选策略等任务信息

GetMessageCallback.description_en: Queries the callback method, callback URL, and event types of event notifications
GetMessageCallback.description_zh: 调用本接口查询事件通知的回调方式、回调地址、事件类型

GetMezzanineInfo.description_en: Retrieves the source file information of an audio or video file, including the file URL, resolution, and bitrate
GetMezzanineInfo.description_zh: 获取音视频的源文件信息，包括文件地址、分辨率、码率等

GetPlayInfo.description_en: Retrieves the playback URL of an audio or video file by providing the audio or video ID, which can then be played using ApsaraVideo Player or a third-party player such as a system-native, open-source, or custom-built player
GetPlayInfo.description_zh: 调用此接口并提供音视频ID即可获取播放地址，随后可使用阿里云播放器或第三方播放器（如系统原生、开源或自研播放器）播放音视频内容

GetTranscodeSummary.description_en: Queries video transcoding summary of one or more audio or video files by their IDs, including video transcoding status and transcoding progress
GetTranscodeSummary.description_zh: 调用本接口根据音视频ID查询音视频转码摘要，包括音视频转码状态、转码进展等汇总信息

GetTranscodeTask.description_en: Queries the details of transcoding jobs based on a transcoding task ID
GetTranscodeTask.description_zh: 调用本接口根据转码任务ID查询转码作业详细信息

GetTranscodeTemplateGroup.description_en: Queries the details of a transcoding configuration by transcoding template group ID
GetTranscodeTemplateGroup.description_zh: 根据转码模板组ID查询转码配置的详细信息

GetUploadDetails.description_en: Retrieves media upload details by media ID, such as upload time, upload ratio, and upload source. Batch retrieval is supported
GetUploadDetails.description_zh: 通过媒体ID获取媒体上传详情（如上传时间、已上传比例、上传来源等信息），支持批量获取

GetVideoInfo.description_en: Retrieves the information about a single audio or video file by audio or video ID, including the title, description, duration, thumbnail URL, status, creation time, size, snapshots, category, and tags
GetVideoInfo.description_zh: 调用本接口通过音/视频ID来获取单个音视频的标题、描述、时长、封面URL、状态、创建时间、大小、截图、分类和标签等信息

GetVideoInfos.description_en: Retrieves the information about multiple audio and video files at a time by audio or video ID, including the title, description, duration, thumbnail URL, status, creation time, size, snapshots, category, and tags
GetVideoInfos.description_zh: 调用本接口通过音/视频ID批量获取多个音视频的标题、描述、时长、封面URL、状态、创建时间、大小、截图、分类和标签等信息

GetVideoList.description_en: Retrieves a list of audio and video information

GetVideoPlayAuth.description_en: Retrieves the playback credential (PlayAuth) for an audio or video file. ApsaraVideo Player SDK uses this credential to automatically obtain the playback URL. Because the playback credential has a validity period and is bound to a specific audio or video file, it cannot be shared or reused. An expired or invalid credential will cause playback failure. This playback method is suitable for audio and video playback scenarios that require high security
GetVideoPlayAuth.description_zh: 调用本接口获取音视频的播放凭证（PlayAuth）。阿里云播放器SDK使用该凭证自动获取播放地址。由于播放凭证具有时效性，且与特定音视频绑定，不可混用或重复使用，因此凭证过期或无效将导致无法播放。此播放方式适用于需要高安全性的音视频播放场景

GetVodTemplate.description_zh: 调用本接口查询单个截图模板

GetWatermark.description_en: Invokes this operation to query the parameter settings of a single image watermark template or text watermark template by watermark template ID, including the position, size, and display time of image watermarks, and the content, font, color, and position of text watermarks
GetWatermark.description_zh: 调用本接口通过水印模板ID查询单个图片水印模板或文字水印模板的配置信息，包括图片水印的位置、大小，展示时间，文字水印的内容、字体、颜色、位置等参数配置信息

GetWorkflowTask.description_en: Queries the execution information of a workflow task
GetWorkflowTask.description_zh: 查询工作流执行任务信息

ListAIImageInfo.description_en: Queries the AI image information of a specified video
ListAIImageInfo.description_zh: 调用本接口查询指定视频下的AI图片信息

ListAIJob.description_en: Queries intelligent tagging or media fingerprint jobs. After you submit an intelligent tagging or media fingerprint job, the job is processed asynchronously. You can call this operation to query job information in real time
ListAIJob.description_zh: 调用本接口查询智能标签或视频DNA作业。在提交智能标签或视频DNA作业后，会进行异步处理，通过此接口可以实时查询作业信息

ListAITemplate.description_en: Queries the list of AI templates
ListAITemplate.description_zh: 调用本接口查询AI模板列表

ListAppInfo.description_en: Queries a list of applications that you are authorized to access based on specified filter conditions
ListAppInfo.description_zh: 调用本接口根据查询条件获取有权限的应用信息列表

ListAppPoliciesForIdentity.description_en: Invokes this operation to list the application permissions granted to a specified account identity (Resource Access Management (RAM) user or RAM role)
ListAppPoliciesForIdentity.description_zh: 调用本接口列出指定账号身份（RAM用户或RAM角色）被授予的应用权限的列表

ListAuditSecurityIp.description_en: Retrieves the list of China Chinese review security IPs
ListAuditSecurityIp.description_zh: 调用本接口获取审核安全IP列表

ListDynamicImage.description_en: Queries the list of animated images for a video by video ID
ListDynamicImage.description_zh: 调用本接口，通过视频ID查询视频截动图列表

ListJobInfo.description_en: Queries the historical task list based on a media asset ID
ListJobInfo.description_zh: 调用本接口根据媒资ID查询历史任务列表

ListLiveRecordVideo.description_en: Retrieves the list of Live to VOD videos
ListLiveRecordVideo.description_zh: 调用本接口获取直播转点播视频列表

ListSnapshots.description_en: Queries snapshots generated by video snapshot jobs and thumbnail snapshots automatically generated by the system during video upload
ListSnapshots.description_zh: 调用本接口可以查询通过视频截图作业生成的截图，以及视频上传时系统生成的封面截图

ListTranscodeTask.description_en: Queries the historical transcoding task information of an audio or video file by its ID. This operation does not return specific job details
ListTranscodeTask.description_zh: 调用本接口根据音视频ID查询音视频历史转码任务信息，本接口不返回具体的作业信息

ListTranscodeTemplateGroup.description_en: Queries the list of transcoding template configurations
ListTranscodeTemplateGroup.description_zh: 调用本接口查询转码模板配置列表

ListVodTemplate.description_en: Queries the list of snapshot templates

ListWatermark.description_en: Invokes this operation to query the parameter settings of all image watermark templates and text watermark templates that have been added in the current service region, including the position, size, and display time of image watermarks, and the content, font, color, position, and other parameter settings of text watermarks
ListWatermark.description_zh: 调用本接口查询当前服务地域下已添加的所有图片水印模板和文字水印模板的配置信息，包括图片水印的位置、大小，展示时间，文字水印的内容、字体、颜色、位置等参数配置信息

MoveAppResource.description_en: Invokes this operation to migrate resources such as media assets from one application to another. Application administrators can directly transfer resources. Resource Access Management (RAM) users or RAM roles must have write permissions on both the source and destination applications. Batch migration is supported
MoveAppResource.description_zh: 调用本接口将媒资等资源从一个应用迁移到另外一个应用。应用管理员可以直接转移，RAM用户或RAM角色需要对资源转移前后的两个应用拥有写权限，支持批量迁移

PreloadVodObjectCaches.description_en: Prefetches content from the origin server to L2 Cache nodes so that the first access directly hits the cache, reducing the load on the origin server
PreloadVodObjectCaches.description_zh: 调用本接口将源站的内容主动预热到L2 Cache节点上，首次访问可直接命中缓存，缓解源站压力

ProduceEditingProjectVideo.description_en: Produces one or more videos into a finished video. You can submit source videos directly through the timeline parameter, or create an online editing project first and then submit it for production
ProduceEditingProjectVideo.description_zh: 将一个或多个视频合成为成品。可以通过时间线参数直接提交源视频，也可以先创建云剪辑工程，再提交合成

RefreshMediaPlayUrls.description_en: Submits a refresh or prefetch task for audio or video files by audio or video ID
RefreshMediaPlayUrls.description_zh: 调用本接口通过音视频ID发起音视频刷新或预热任务

RefreshUploadVideo.description_en: Refreshes the upload credential for a video file after the upload times out
RefreshUploadVideo.description_zh: 用于视频文件上传超时后重新获取视频上传凭证

RefreshVodObjectCaches.description_en: Purges file content on nodes. Specifies URL content to purge on cache nodes, and supports batch URL purging
RefreshVodObjectCaches.description_zh: 调用本接口刷新节点上的文件内容。指定URL内容刷新至Cache节点，支持URL批量刷新

RegisterMedia.description_en: Registers media assets. Existing media files stored in your own OSS bucket that is connected to ApsaraVideo VOD must be registered to generate the associated data required by VOD before you can use VOD features such as transcoding and snapshotting
RegisterMedia.description_zh: 进行媒资注册，接入点播服务的OSS自有Bucket上的存量媒资文件，需要进行媒资注册生成点播需要的关联数据后，才能正常使用点播提供的转码、截图等功能

RestoreMedia.description_en: Restores media assets from frozen storage

SearchEditingProject.description_en: Searches for online editing projects (video editing lists)
SearchEditingProject.description_zh: 调用本接口搜索云剪辑工程（视频编辑列表）

SearchMedia.description_en: Searches for media asset information such as videos, audio files, and images produced by ApsaraVideo VOD. You can use this operation with the media asset search protocol to perform multi-dimensional searches in ApsaraVideo VOD, including specifying return fields, exact matching, fuzzy matching, multi-value queries, range queries, and sort fields
SearchMedia.description_zh: 本接口用于搜索视频点播生产的视频、音频和图片等媒资信息，调用本接口配合媒资搜索协议可实现在视频点播中进行指定返回字段、精确匹配、模糊匹配、多值查询、范围查询、排序字段等多方式多维度的搜索查询

SetAppPlayKey.description_en: Sets the playback key for an application

SetAuditSecurityIp.description_en: Sets the review security IP addresses
SetAuditSecurityIp.description_zh: 调用本接口设置审核安全IP

SetCrossdomainContent.description_en: Updates the content of the cross-domain file crossdomain.xml for ApsaraVideo VOD
SetCrossdomainContent.description_zh: 调用本接口更新点播跨域文件crossdomain.xml的内容

SetDefaultAITemplate.description_zh: 调用本接口设置默认AI模板

SetDefaultTranscodeTemplateGroup.description_en: Sets the default transcoding template group configuration
SetDefaultTranscodeTemplateGroup.description_zh: 调用本接口设置默认转码模板配置

SetDefaultWatermark.description_en: Sets a specified watermark template as the default watermark template
SetDefaultWatermark.description_zh: 调用本接口将指定水印模板设置为默认水印模板

SetEditingProjectMaterials.description_en: Sets the materials to be edited for an online editing project
SetEditingProjectMaterials.description_zh: 调用本接口设置云剪辑工程的待剪辑素材

SetMessageCallback.description_en: Sets the callback method, callback URL, and event types for event notifications
SetMessageCallback.description_zh: 调用本接口设置事件通知的回调方式、回调地址、事件类型

SetVodDomainCertificate.description_en: Configures whether the certificate feature is enabled for a specified domain name and modifies certificate information
SetVodDomainCertificate.description_zh: 调用本接口设置某域名下证书功能是否启用及修改证书信息

SetVodDomainSSLCertificate.description_en: Sets whether the certificate feature is enabled for a specified domain name and updates the certificate information
SetVodDomainSSLCertificate.description_zh: 调用本接口用于设置某域名下证书功能是否启用及更新证书信息

SubmitAIImageAuditJob.description_en: Submits an automated review task for an image. The task is asynchronously executed after it is submitted. The task may not be complete when the response is returned
SubmitAIImageAuditJob.description_zh: 调用本接口来提交图片智能审核任务，作业在提交成功后会异步执行，不保证接口返回时作业已处理完成

SubmitAIImageJob.description_en: Submits an AI image processing task
SubmitAIImageJob.description_zh: 调用本接口提交AI图片处理任务

SubmitAIJob.description_en: Submits an intelligent tagging or media fingerprint job
SubmitAIJob.description_zh: 调用本接口提交智能标签或视频DNA作业

SubmitAIMediaAuditJob.description_en: Submits an automated review job for audio and video files. The job is executed asynchronously after submission, and the job may not be complete when the response is returned
SubmitAIMediaAuditJob.description_zh: 调用本接口提交音视频智能审核作业。作业在提交成功后会异步执行，不保证接口返回时作业已处理完成

SubmitDigitalWatermarkExtractJob.description_en: Submits a digital watermarking (copyright watermark or tracing watermark) extraction job to asynchronously extract a copyright watermark or tracing watermark
SubmitDigitalWatermarkExtractJob.description_zh: 通过调用本接口提交数字水印（版权水印或溯源水印）提取作业，开始异步提取版权水印或溯源水印

SubmitDynamicImageJob.description_en: Submits a media animated image job for asynchronous processing
SubmitDynamicImageJob.description_zh: 调用本接口提交媒体动图作业，开始异步处理

SubmitMediaDNADeleteJob.description_zh: 调用本接口删除视频DNA作业

SubmitPreprocessJobs.description_en: Transcodes a video by using a China Production Studio (China Production Studio) for preprocessing
SubmitPreprocessJobs.description_zh: 调用本接口通过导播台对视频进行转码处理

SubmitSnapshotJob.description_en: Submits a video snapshot job to start asynchronous snapshot processing
SubmitSnapshotJob.description_zh: 调用本接口提交视频截图作业，开始异步截图处理

SubmitTranscodeJobs.description_en: Submits a media transcoding job to start asynchronous transcoding
SubmitTranscodeJobs.description_zh: 调用本接口提交媒体转码作业，开始异步转码处理

SubmitWorkflowJob.description_en: Initiates a VOD workflow for a video
SubmitWorkflowJob.description_zh: 对视频发起点播工作流处理

UpdateAppInfo.description_zh: 调用本接口更新应用信息

UpdateAttachedMediaInfos.description_en: Batch updates the information of auxiliary media assets, such as title, description, tags, and category, by specifying the unique identifiers (IDs) of the auxiliary media assets that have been uploaded to ApsaraVideo VOD, including watermarked images, subtitle files, and other materials
UpdateAttachedMediaInfos.description_zh: 当将带有水印的图片、字幕文件或其它素材等辅助媒体资源上传至视频点播后，可以通过本接口依据这些辅助媒体的唯一标识符（ID），批量更新它们的标题、描述、标签及分类等信息

UpdateCategory.description_en: Updates the name of a category
UpdateCategory.description_zh: 调用本接口对分类名称进行修改更新

UpdateEditingProject.description_en: Modifies an online editing project (video editing task)
UpdateEditingProject.description_zh: 调用本接口修改云剪辑工程（视频编辑任务）

UpdateImageInfos.description_en: Batch modifies the title, description, tags, and category information of images by image ID after the images are uploaded to ApsaraVideo VOD
UpdateImageInfos.description_zh: 图片上传到视频点播后，可以调用本接口通过图片ID批量修改图片的标题、描述、标签和分类信息

UpdateMediaStorageClass.description_en: Modifies the storage class of a media asset

UpdateTranscodeTemplateGroup.description_en: Modifies transcoding configurations. You can modify the configuration of a specified transcoding template in a transcoding template group
UpdateTranscodeTemplateGroup.description_zh: 调用本接口修改转码配置信息，可修改转码模板组下指定的转码模板配置

UpdateVideoInfo.description_en: Modifies the information about a single audio or video file

UpdateVideoInfos.description_en: Modifies the information about multiple audio and video files at a time

UpdateVodDomain.description_zh: 调用本接口修改加速域名

UpdateWatermark.description_en: Modifies the name and watermark configuration (WatermarkConfig) of an image and text watermark template that was added by calling the AddWatermark operation
UpdateWatermark.description_zh: 添加图文水印模板后，可以调用本接口修改图文水印模板的模板名称和水印配置（WatermarkConfig）

UploadMediaByURL.description_en: Pulls audio and video media files for upload based on source file URLs. Batch upload is supported
UploadMediaByURL.description_zh: 基于源文件URL，拉取音视频媒体文件进行上传，支持批量上传

UploadStreamByURL.description_en: Uploads a transcoded stream file from external storage and mounts it to the corresponding ApsaraVideo VOD media asset
UploadStreamByURL.description_zh: 上传外部存储的转码流文件并挂载到对应的点播媒资下

VerifyVodDomainOwner.description_en: Calls this operation to verify domain name ownership
VerifyVodDomainOwner.description_zh: 调用本接口验证域名归属权
